title: Lumi's Shadow Theatre Surprise | Light and Shadow Song for Kids

music.sound_policy: Switches, paper, curtains, footsteps and audience responses are synchronized effects and never spoken imitation words.

creative_intent: Turn one simple lamp-and-puppet experiment into a gentle theatre mystery, helping children see that a shadow grows near the light, shrinks near the screen and can look surprising without being frightening.
visual_system: handcrafted cut-paper shadow theatre with indigo velvet proscenium, warm amber silk screen, visible layered-paper edges, brass lamp details and restrained cyan-magenta backstage accents

motion_language.easing_family: soft cubic ease with a tiny paper-puppet settle
motion_language.transition_family: match cuts through lamp circles, puppet rods and expanding shadow shapes
motion_language.motion_intensity: one hero shadow change per scene; guide and curtain responses below half amplitude; dust motes only as ambient texture
motion_language.hold_discipline: one full beat of stillness after each shadow-size reveal

character_lock.lumi: Lumi, seven-year-old South Asian-Australian girl, warm brown skin, dark curly hair in two low puffs, teal overalls over a saffron long-sleeve shirt, plum canvas shoes
character_lock.guide: Ms Noor, kind older theatre guide with silver bob, round glasses, berry cardigan, navy skirt and a brass star brooch
character_lock.theatre: small handcrafted community shadow theatre with indigo velvet curtains, warm amber silk screen, one guarded brass stage lamp, cut-paper puppets and clearly marked floor positions

scenes.visual_action: Backstage, Lumi waits beside Ms Noor while the guarded brass lamp is off. Ms Noor points out the lamp, amber screen and one small rabbit puppet before switching the lamp on.
lyrics: Velvet curtains hide a stage of gold,
Lumi finds a paper friend to hold,
Lamp, puppet, screen all stand in line,
Ms Noor brings the little light to shine.
scenes.camera: slow backstage reveal ending on the aligned lamp, puppet and screen

scenes.visual_action: Lumi places the rabbit puppet close to the silk screen on the marked near-screen star. A small crisp rabbit shadow appears while Ms Noor holds the lamp guard steady.
lyrics: Near the screen, the rabbit shadow's small,
Crisp little ears are standing on the wall,
Hold the rod and let the puppet rest,
Small and clear, our first shadow test.
scenes.camera: side cutaway showing lamp-puppet-screen spacing and small shadow together

scenes.visual_action: Lumi slides the same rabbit puppet along a marked floor track toward the guarded lamp. The rabbit shadow grows visibly larger on the screen without changing puppet identity.
lyrics: Slide toward the lamp along the track,
Watch the rabbit shadow stretch its back,
Closer to the light means growing wide,
One small puppet, giant shape outside.
scenes.camera: locked side view with the expanding shadow as the only bold movement

scenes.visual_action: Lumi overlaps one paper circle and two paper triangles on rods. Their combined shadow becomes an owl face; the three source shapes remain visible beside the screen.
lyrics: One round circle, triangles two,
Layer their shadows; what comes into view?
Wide owl eyes and ears appear,
Shapes can join when light is near.
scenes.camera: shape-to-shadow match cut resolving on the complete owl

scenes.visual_action: A large unfamiliar shadow crosses the curtain and Lumi pauses. Ms Noor slowly parts the curtain to reveal the harmless rabbit puppet tilted beside a leafy paper branch; Lumi relaxes and smiles.
lyrics: Something tall is crossing through the glow,
Lumi stops and breathes before we know,
Curtain opens: rabbit, branch and light,
Odd-shaped shadows can be safe and bright.
scenes.camera: still suspense frame followed by one gentle curtain reveal

scenes.visual_action: Lumi performs three marked rabbit positions in order: near screen small, middle medium and near lamp large. Ms Noor points to three matching size cards below the stage.
lyrics: Small by the screen, then middle-sized,
Big by the lamp makes Lumi surprised,
Three clear places, three sizes show,
Move it with care and the shadow will grow.
scenes.camera: three phrase-aligned match cuts on the same rabbit silhouette

scenes.visual_action: The curtains open for a tiny audience. Lumi and Ms Noor perform a rabbit, owl and flying bird shadow parade, then return the rabbit to the small-middle-large sequence for the final musical answer.
lyrics: Rabbit, owl and bird take flight,
Paper friends are dancing in the light,
Near makes big and far makes small,
Lumi's shadow song now shines for all.
scenes.camera: audience-wide reveal ending in a slow push toward the three-size rabbit finale

quality_gates: Lumi, Ms Noor, their clothes, the guarded lamp, rabbit puppet and theatre palette remain consistent.
Every lamp interaction is supervised and the hot bulb remains behind its guard.
The near-screen rabbit shadow is visibly smaller than the middle and near-lamp versions.
The owl visibly derives from exactly one circle and two triangles.
The suspense shadow resolves visibly into familiar paper objects without a frightening payoff.
Every lyric and effect remains inside the matching visible scene.
No switch, paper, curtain, step or applause sound is spoken as imitation.
Every story scene is four four-beat bars (11.428571 seconds) and below 14 seconds.
Final output includes full decode, visual, transition, size-progression and lyric-emotion-sync evidence.
